summary: Phase 3 end-to-end validated (backend + frontend). Backend: 18/18 pytest pass covering role-scoped auth (admin/montaj/bayi), quotes CRUD + convert + convert-twice-blocked (400) + role guards, assembly create/patch/advance/photo upload+download roundtrip through Emergent Object Storage, duplicate order → assembly returns 409, custom per-user access override on POST/PATCH /api/users. Frontend Playwright E2E on public URL: (1) admin/montaj1/bayi1 all login; (2) sidebar filtering — bayi sees exactly [Genel Bakış, Teklif Hazırla, Teklifler]; montaj sees [Genel Bakış, Siparişler, Montaj Portalı]; admin sees all 12 including Teklifler + Montaj Portalı; (3) Configurator → gardirop template → filled name/customer/phone/address + Bayi %15 discount → 'Teklif olarak kaydet' returned banner '✓ TKF-2609-0004 teklifi kaydedildi'; (4) Quotes page listed 4 quotes, status dropdown persisted 'Gönderildi', PDF download fired file teklif-TKF-2609-0004.pdf, 'Siparişe' convert produced 'Siparişe döndü' badge; (5) Orders 'Montaja Gönder' created assembly job with success banner; second click on same order returned Turkish 409 error 'Bu sipariş zaten montaja gönderilmiş'; (6) Assembly portal — manual add works, 'Montaja Başla' moved Bekliyor→Başladı, photo upload via file input rendered image (blob URL, img.complete=true, naturalWidth>0); (7) Users edit modal for bayi1 rendered 'Özel sayfa erişimi' block with 11 access-* checkboxes.

issues: Benign console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Same warning already documented in iteration_8; caused by the visual-editor wrapper injecting <span> inside <option> for dynamic Turkish text. Purely cosmetic, no functional impact — leaving as-is per prior iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py convert_quote returns 400 instead of 409 for already-converted quotes (line 807). Frontend test expects 'idempotent block' and both 400/409 are semantically acceptable, but 409 (Conflict) is more idiomatic for 'resource already in target state'.

server.py assembly duplicate check only prevents second job when order_id is provided (line 859). Manual assembly jobs without order_id could still be duplicated — acceptable per spec (manual jobs) but worth noting.

AssemblyPage.js Photo component fetches every image via authenticated axios GET → blob → URL.createObjectURL on mount; there is no client-side cache. If a job has many photos and the list re-renders, each Photo remounts and re-downloads. Consider memoising url by storage_path or lifting fetch to parent.

QuotesPage.js generateQuotePDF uses ASCII transliteration for Turkish chars (jsPDF standard fonts don't support UTF-8). Works but customer names/addresses lose diacritics in PDF. Consider bundling a Unicode font (e.g. Roboto via jsPDF-autotable font) for proper Türkçe rendering.

server.py file download endpoint /api/files/{path:path} streams via Response(content=data) — for large files this loads full bytes in memory. Given the 10 MB image cap this is fine, but a StreamingResponse would be safer if future videos/PDFs are added.

auth.py ROLES list adds 'bayi' correctly. However backend has no CSRF protection on the cookie-auth path; since frontend uses Bearer localStorage token, cookie is effectively unused. Consider dropping the cookie or adding SameSite=strict + CSRF to reduce attack surface.
AssemblyPage.js photo upload query-string caption not URL-safe if it contains #/&; encodeURIComponent is applied — good.

Users access-block only exposes 11 keys (dashboard/configurator/quotes/products/materials/customers/orders/assembly/discounts/sales/expenses). The routes 'sevkiyat/shipping' and 'users' are omitted intentionally (admin-only); confirmed with AuthContext.canAccess. OK.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_/TEST_UI_ prefixed quotes, orders and assembly jobs, and one temporary TEST_acc_* user (deleted). One tiny PNG uploaded to Emergent Object Storage under mad-mobilya/assembly/{job}/. Non-destructive.
